gates.requirement: Resolve the exact runtime Charon revision and derive its required Rust channel from that revision's toolchain source.
gates.failure_condition: Anneal's proposed Rust channel differs from the runtime Charon requirement without an explicitly scoped compatibility experiment.

gates.requirement: For every supported host, fetch and merge cargo, rustc, host rust-std, rustc-dev, llvm-tools, miri, and rust-src for the selected date, and update fixed-output hashes.
gates.failure_condition: Any required component is unavailable, mismatched, or not represented in the packaged sysroot.

gates.requirement: From the installed archive, verify rustc/cargo identity, Charon's effective sysroot, rustc dynamic-library resolution, and one complete Charon extraction.
gates.failure_condition: The packaged compiler differs from the intended channel, Charon cannot load/use rustc-private libraries, or extraction fails.

gates.requirement: Feed representative LLBC produced by the upgraded rustc/Charon pair to the selected Aeneas revision and generate Lean successfully.
gates.failure_condition: Aeneas rejects or misinterprets the new Charon output.

gates.requirement: Run preserved old-versus-new MIR/ULLBC/LLBC fixtures over control flow, unsafe operations, layout, drop/unwind, generics/traits, generated code, dependencies, and source identity; classify material deltas.
gates.failure_condition: A material semantic delta is unexplained or invalidates Anneal's source/model assumptions.

gates.requirement: Query current CATALOG.json for reports bound to the old rustc, Rust Reference, and Charon identities; revalidate material claims affected by changed source or probe output.
gates.failure_condition: Anneal adopts the new baseline while relying on unreviewed revision-sensitive facts known to bind the old toolchain.

gates.requirement: Ensure release metadata or an isolated development namespace makes Exocrate select the newly built archive rather than an existing installation.
gates.failure_condition: Testing can resolve to a prior installation because flake-only changes did not change Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock-derived identity.

gates.requirement: Build and smoke-test the omnibus archive on Linux/macOS x86_64/aarch64, including dynamic-link and relocation/fixup behavior relevant to the platform.
gates.failure_condition: The upgrade succeeds only on a subset of Anneal's declared archive platforms without explicitly narrowing support.

gates.requirement: Record immutable toolchain identities, hashes, fixture outputs, and materially changed reference findings for the new baseline.
gates.failure_condition: The new baseline cannot be revalidated without rediscovering its compiler/Charon relationship or semantic deltas.
